results.description:
The first time I met Ryker Vance, I told him I had a good aim.

I meant it. I'd driven away from a broken marriage with my son asleep in the back seat and nothing left to lose.

Now the most dangerous man in Cinder Falls keeps showing up. On a rain-soaked road. In my classroom. On my front porch when trouble comes knocking.

He's the president of the Steel Saints MC, all leather and quiet patience. And he looks at my curves like they're something worth worshipping.

I promised myself I'd never let another man close. My son can't lose anyone else.

But the past I ran from has followed me into these mountains, and Ryker swears he'll stand in the road for us.

How do I trust a man built for trouble when he might be the only one who can keep us safe?

Steamy small-town romance. Curvy single mom. Protective alpha MC president. Instant attraction. Found family. Guaranteed HEA.
